pages.title: Files
pages.one: One search over every file here: your folders and the files helpers made for tickets.

steps.text: You or a helper save a file in the folder or on a ticket
Walks the folder and the ticket files
steps.detail: Skips links and program folders such as node_modules and .git. In your folders it also skips what .gitignore leaves out. Ticket files are the files and evidence of each ticket.

steps.text: Writes the names first, then reads the text
steps.detail: Only new or changed files are read again. Private files (secret-looking names, key files) are found by name only; their text is never shown.

steps.text: You or a helper search a name or words inside
steps.detail: Any part of a word matches, accents do not matter: muller finds Müller.

steps.text: Name hits first, then files that hold the words, with the matching line

good: Files only reads your files: it never changes, moves or deletes one. It writes only its own index.
No AI call: the search is one index on this computer. Delete it any time; it builds itself again.

cmds: find a file by name or by text
bring the index up to date now
